summary:
Comprehensive implementation plan for:
1. Dynamic 5-day weather forecast component on every tour detail page powered by Open-Meteo free API with Karakoram & Himalayan high-altitude coordinates (Skardu, Gilgit, Askole, Hunza, Fairy Meadows, etc.).
2. Seamless guest booking, inquiry, and instant reservation persistence to Firebase Firestore with guest tagging and full real-time visibility in the Admin Panel.
3. Official downloadable PDF booking voucher generator with QR verification code, Government of Pakistan DTS Lic. #1842 certification, and traveler expedition paperwork.
